title: Host Starter Bundle, Editable Welcome Book Template, Cleaning Checklist, Wifi and House Rules Signs, Vacation Rental Canva Templates
description:
Everything you need to run a polished, five-star short term rental, in one matching set. Save $7 compared to buying each item separately.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (28 pages)
1. Editable Welcome Book (12 pages): host note, check-in/out, Wi-Fi, house rules, how things work, emergency info, where to eat, things to do, check-out checklist, review page
2. Turnover Cleaning Checklist (8 pages, 95+ tasks): room-by-room lists, final walk-through, damage report, cleaning log
3. Host Signs (8 signs, 8 x 10 in): welcome, Wi-Fi, house rules, check-out, check-in times, trash & recycling, quiet hours, shoes off

YOU WILL RECEIVE
- A PDF with your Canva template links (free Canva account is enough)
- Print-ready PDFs in US Letter
- A4 versions in one ZIP file

EASY TO CUSTOMIZE
Change all text, colors and fonts in Canva. Drag in your own photos. Print, or share the welcome book as a digital link.

PLEASE NOTE
- This is a DIGITAL product. No physical item will be shipped.
- Photos are not included; placeholders show where to add your own.
- For use in your own rental properties. Please do not resell or share the templates.
- Designed with the help of AI tools, then reviewed and finalized by me.

Questions or need a custom version? Send me a message, I usually reply within 24 hours.
